# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this extension, please report it
responsibly. **Do not open a public GitHub issue.**

Instead, report the issue by opening a private security advisory on GitHub:

<https://github.com/your-username/bookmark-search/security/advisories/new>

Please include as much detail as possible:

* A clear description of the vulnerability
* Steps to reproduce the issue
* The potential impact (what an attacker could do)
* Any mitigations you have already tried

We will acknowledge receipt of your report within 72 hours and aim to provide
a fix or mitigation timeline shortly after.

## Supported Versions

Only the latest released version of the extension receives security updates.

## Scope

This extension only accesses your local Firefox bookmark data. It does not
make any network requests. If you believe you have found a vulnerability
related to the bookmark API access, please report it as described above.
